events.verdict: Murphy III (NOP) establishes a screening position in Washington's (DAL) path and does not deliver illegal contact as he sets the pick.
Murray (NOP) is moving forward prior to marginal body contact occurring with Dinwiddie's (DAL) side.
McCollum (NOP) is moving alongside Dinwiddie's (DAL) path and marginal body contact occurs as Dinwiddie spins into the lane at the end of the drive.
Murray (NOP) closes out toward the corner and marginal contact occurs with Washington's (DAL) front after Washington receives the pass.
Washington (DAL) does not release the shot attempt prior to the expiration of the shot clock. The 24 second violation is correctly whistled.
Gafford (DAL) legally contests Murray's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Green (NOP) legally contests Thompson's (DAL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Murray (NOP) extends his off-arm into Gafford's (DAL) head/face during the rebound.
Murray (NOP) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Dallas.
Thompson (DAL) lifts his pivot foot and returns to the floor before releasing the pass.
Missi (NOP) and Gafford (DAL) engage for position and when the players disengage, Gafford loses his balance on his own accord. Missi does not dislodge Gafford from his position.
McCollum (NOP) makes clean contact with the ball and causes Thompson (DAL) to lose control of it on the wing.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds call pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Thompson (DAL) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds. Possession is awarded to New Orleans.
Marshall (DAL) engages with Murphy III (NOP) as Murphy III moves to set the pick and marginal contact occurs before the pick expires.
Washington (DAL) is drawn into the air on the pump fake toward Murray (NOP) and initiates illegal contact during his upward shooting motion.
Green (NOP) jumps forwards into Washington (DAL) and initiates body contact that causes Washington to become dislodged during the inbound pass.
Grimes (DAL) has his right hand resting on McCollum's (NOP) right side and marginal contact occurs prior to Grimes cleanly deflecting the inbound pass away.
Grimes (DAL) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds.
Marshall (DAL) has his right hand momentarily around Hawkins' (NOP) right side and quickly removes it prior to Hawkins gaining control of the inbound.
Washington (DAL) cleanly dislodges the ball from Hawkins' (NOP) possession and any arm contact is marginal.
Murphy III (NOP) is drifting forward as he contests the shot attempt and marginal contact occurs with Dinwiddie's (DAL) slightly extended left arm and leg.
Murphy III (NOP) blocks the shot attempt after the ball makes contact with the backboard and has a chance to score.
Washington (DAL) brings his hands toward Murphy III's (NOP) front and marginal contact occurs as Murphy III is jumping backward to save the ball back into play.
Washington (DAL) commits a take foul on Murphy III (NOP).
Murray (NOP) legally contests Marshall's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
